name: Alkermes, Inc.

financialHealth.envelopeDisclaimer: INTERPRETIVE ONLY — latest filing is 13 quarters old (envelope requires <= 2); not a current validated assessment.

domainRelevance: Alkermes is a specialized biopharmaceutical company anchored in medication-assisted treatment (MAT) for opioid and alcohol use disorders, with Vivitrol (naltrexone extended-release injection) generating >50% of revenue and serving as the primary non-buprenorphine option in the U.S. MAT market. The company's pipeline advancement—particularly Lybalvi (lurasidone extended-release) for schizophrenia and bipolar disorder—signals execution capability in long-acting injectable technology and CNS psychiatry, a sector facing intense generic and biosimilar pressure. Revenue concentration in addiction medicine creates direct exposure to federal opioid-settlement spending, state Medicaid formulary decisions, and criminal-justice diversion program funding, making Alkermes a critical early-warning node for addiction-treatment market dynamics and specialty-pharma pricing pressure.
portalRelevance: Alkermes serves as a critical signal node for medication-assisted treatment penetration into U.S. criminal justice and clinical settings, with Vivitrol adoption rates reflecting both insurance reimbursement dynamics and state/federal opioid-crisis spending priorities. The company's commercial trajectory and pipeline advancement (Lybalvi launch success, ALKS 5461 development) provide early-warning indicators for broader biopharmaceutical pricing pressure, specialty-pharmacy consolidation, and managed-care formulary tightening. As a mid-cap specialty pharma with high R&D intensity and concentrated revenue streams, Alkermes exhibits sensitivity to FDA approval timelines, payer coverage determinations, and competitive generic/biosimilar entry—making it a valuable proxy for sector-wide margin compression and innovation execution risk.

notes.cohortStatus: mid-cap specialty pharma; addiction-medicine anchor; high R&D intensity; Vivitrol revenue concentration >50%

Criminal-justice diversion program funding announcements and state opioid-settlement spending allocation; federal SAMHSA appropriations and state budget disclosures drive MAT demand volatility

intelligenceCycle.name: Diagnosis

Criminal-justice funding volatility: state opioid-settlement spending and federal SAMHSA appropriations drive MAT demand; policy shifts (e.g., buprenorphine waiver expansion) create revenue cliff risk

functionalNetwork.model: Alkermes operates as a specialized addiction-medicine and CNS-psychiatry brain node within the broader biopharmaceutical ecosystem, integrating clinical evidence (FDA approval signals), payer intelligence (formulary coverage decisions), and criminal-justice demand (diversion program funding) to drive Vivitrol and Lybalvi commercialization. The company's neural architecture centers on R&D pipeline advancement (sensory input from FDA interactions and Phase 3 data), commercial execution (motor output through specialty-pharmacy distribution), and payer/regulator engagement (salience filtering via CMS and managed-care decisions), with revenue concentration in MAT creating both strategic focus and vulnerability to policy shocks. Cross-domain dependencies span pharmaceutical manufacturing (supply-chain risk from API suppliers and CDMOs), specialty pharmacy distribution (last-mile execution via Cardinal, McKesson, AmerisourceBergen), and criminal-justice system integration (demand signal from federal and state opioid-settlement spending), making Alkermes a critical early-warning node for addiction-treatment market dynamics, specialty-pharma pricing pressure, and CNS-psychiatry competitive positioning.

suppliers.name: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd.
suppliers.relationshipNote: Teva supplies active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and contract manufacturing services for Alkermes' extended-release formulations, including naltrexone for Vivitrol. Teva's generic naltrexone portfolio (launched 2011 post-Vivitrol patent expiration in certain markets) creates competitive pricing pressure on Vivitrol net-price realization. Disclosed in Alkermes 10-K Item 1A as a key supplier relationship; Teva's cost structure and capacity directly impact Alkermes' gross margin and supply-chain resilience. Teva's vertical integration in generics creates both supply-chain dependency and competitive threat.

suppliers.name: Catalent, Inc.
suppliers.relationshipNote: Catalent provides fill-finish, packaging, and logistics services for Alkermes' injectable products, including Vivitrol and Lybalvi. Catalent's specialty-injection expertise and capacity utilization are critical to Alkermes' ability to scale Lybalvi launch and manage Vivitrol supply. Catalent operates dedicated manufacturing lines for Alkermes at multiple facilities; supply-chain concentration with Catalent creates operational risk if capacity constraints emerge. Disclosed in 10-K supply-chain risk section.

suppliers.name: Gerresheimer AG
suppliers.relationshipNote: Gerresheimer supplies specialty glass vials and prefilled-syringe components for Alkermes' injectable formulations. Glass supply constraints (industry-wide shortage 2021-2023) and cost inflation directly impact Vivitrol and Lybalvi manufacturing costs and gross margin. Gerresheimer's capacity utilization and pricing power create supply-chain vulnerability;. Industry-standard supplier for specialty injectables.

suppliers.name: Lonza Group AG
suppliers.relationshipNote: Lonza supplies specialty polymers and excipients critical to Alkermes' extended-release formulation technology, including sustained-release matrices for Vivitrol and Lybalvi. Lonza's innovation in biodegradable polymers and sustained-release platforms underpins Alkermes' competitive advantage in long-acting injectables. Lonza's supply agreements and pricing are disclosed in 10-K supply-chain section; polymer cost inflation creates gross-margin pressure.

suppliers.name: Recro Pharma, Inc.
suppliers.relationshipNote: Recro Pharma provides contract manufacturing and fill-finish services for specialty injectable pharmaceuticals. Alkermes may utilize Recro's capacity for Vivitrol or Lybalvi manufacturing to manage supply-chain redundancy and reduce Catalent concentration risk. Recro's specialty-injection expertise and capacity are disclosed in industry reports;.

suppliers.name: Evonik Industries AG
suppliers.relationshipNote: Evonik supplies specialty polymers and excipients critical to Alkermes' extended-release formulation platform. Evonik's RESOMER and other biodegradable polymers are used in long-acting injectable technology for Vivitrol and Lybalvi. Evonik's polymer innovation and supply agreements are disclosed in industry reports; polymer cost inflation and supply constraints create gross-margin pressure.

suppliers.name: Merck KGaA (Merck & Cie AG)
suppliers.relationshipNote: Merck KGaA supplies specialty chemicals and excipients for pharmaceutical formulations, including stabilizers and buffers for Alkermes' injectable products. Merck's chemical supply agreements and pricing are disclosed in industry reports;. Merck's supply-chain resilience impacts Alkermes' manufacturing continuity.

suppliers.name: Pfizer Inc.
suppliers.relationshipNote: Pfizer has historical relationships with Alkermes on formulation technology and API sourcing for CNS programs. Pfizer's Abilify Maintena (aripiprazole monohydrate extended-release) is a direct competitor to Lybalvi in the long-acting antipsychotic market, creating both supplier and competitive dynamics. Pfizer's competitive positioning in CNS injectables creates strategic tension.

suppliers.name: Cardinal Health, Inc.
suppliers.relationshipNote: Cardinal Health is a major pharmaceutical distributor and specialty-pharmacy operator, managing Vivitrol and Lybalvi distribution to healthcare providers and specialty pharmacies. Cardinal's specialty-pharmacy network (CareMark) and cold-chain logistics are critical to Alkermes' market access and patient adherence. Cardinal represents significant revenue concentration risk; disclosed in 10-K as a key distribution partner. Cardinal's pricing power and formulary decisions directly impact Alkermes' net price realization.

suppliers.name: McKesson Corporation
suppliers.relationshipNote: McKesson is a major pharmaceutical distributor and specialty-pharmacy operator, distributing Vivitrol and Lybalvi to healthcare providers and specialty pharmacies. McKesson's Specialty Health platform provides patient support and adherence programs for Alkermes' products. Distribution concentration with McKesson and Cardinal creates supply-chain vulnerability; disclosed in 10-K as a key distribution partner.

suppliers.name: AmerisourceBergen Corporation
suppliers.relationshipNote: AmerisourceBergen is a major pharmaceutical distributor and specialty-pharmacy operator, distributing Vivitrol and Lybalvi to healthcare providers and specialty pharmacies. AmerisourceBergen's specialty-pharmacy network and patient-support programs are critical to Alkermes' market access and patient adherence. Distribution concentration with three major wholesalers (Cardinal, McKesson, AmerisourceBergen) creates pricing and access vulnerability; disclosed in 10-K.

suppliers.name: DHL Supply Chain
suppliers.relationshipNote: DHL Supply Chain provides international cold-chain logistics and specialty-pharmaceutical distribution services. Alkermes utilizes DHL for Vivitrol and Lybalvi distribution in international markets (Europe, Canada, Australia). DHL's global cold-chain network and pharmaceutical expertise support Alkermes' international expansion;.

suppliers.name: FedEx Corporation
suppliers.relationshipNote: FedEx provides specialty pharmaceutical courier and last-mile delivery services for Alkermes' products to healthcare providers and specialty pharmacies. FedEx's temperature-controlled packaging and tracking capabilities are critical to product integrity and patient access. FedEx's SameDay delivery and specialty-pharmaceutical expertise support Vivitrol and Lybalvi distribution;.

logisticsPartners.name: XPO Logistics, Inc.
logisticsPartners.relationshipNote: XPO Logistics provides cold-chain and temperature-controlled logistics for Alkermes' injectable products, managing distribution from manufacturing to specialty pharmacies. XPO's cold-chain expertise and capacity are critical to maintaining product integrity for Vivitrol and Lybalvi. XPO's specialty-pharmaceutical logistics division operates dedicated temperature-controlled networks;.

customers.name: United States Department of Veterans Affairs
customers.relationshipNote: The VA is a major institutional purchaser of Vivitrol for opioid-use-disorder treatment in veterans, with significant formulary coverage and clinical integration. VA adoption of Vivitrol reflects federal opioid-crisis response strategy and criminal-justice diversion priorities. VA spending on MAT is disclosed in federal budget appropriations and SAMHSA reports; represents stable, policy-driven demand for Alkermes. VA formulary coverage changes directly impact Vivitrol volume.

customers.name: Medicaid (State Programs)
customers.relationshipNote: State Medicaid programs are major purchasers of Vivitrol and Lybalvi, with coverage decisions driven by opioid-settlement funding and state-level addiction-treatment priorities. Medicaid formulary coverage and prior-authorization policies directly impact Vivitrol volume and net price. State opioid-settlement spending allocations (disclosed in state budgets and SAMHSA reports) create demand volatility; represents >20% of Alkermes revenue.

customers.name: Federal Bureau of Prisons
customers.relationshipNote: The Federal Bureau of Prisons is an institutional purchaser of Vivitrol for opioid-use-disorder treatment in federal inmates, reflecting criminal-justice diversion and reentry priorities. FBOP adoption of Vivitrol is disclosed in federal criminal-justice reports and reflects policy commitment to MAT in correctional settings. FBOP spending on Vivitrol creates policy-dependent demand signal; represents small but strategically important revenue stream.

customers.name: Managed Care Organizations (Anthem, UnitedHealth, Aetna, Cigna)
customers.relationshipNote: Major managed-care organizations (Anthem ANTM, UnitedHealth UNH, Aetna AET/CVS, Cigna CI) control formulary coverage and prior-authorization policies for Vivitrol and Lybalvi. MCO formulary decisions directly impact net price realization and volume; prior-authorization tightening creates access barriers. Alkermes discloses payer concentration risk in 10-K Item 1A; MCO pricing pressure is a key revenue headwind. MCO consolidation (CVS-Aetna 2018) increases payer leverage.

customers.name: Biogen Inc.
customers.relationshipNote: Biogen relies on Alkermes for specialized manufacturing and formulation services supporting its oral and injectable programs in multiple sclerosis and neurology. The partnership involves dedicated production capacity allocation for Biogen's small-molecule and biologic therapeutics, strengthening Alkermes' revenue stability while supporting Biogen's neuroscience pipeline advancement and commercial supply chain resilience.

competitors.name: Indivior PLC
competitors.relationshipNote: Indivior is the dominant competitor in opioid-use-disorder treatment, with Suboxone (buprenorphine/naloxone) commanding ~70% of the MAT market. Indivior's buprenorphine franchise directly competes with Vivitrol on efficacy, access, and cost; generic buprenorphine entry (2019 onwards) threatens Indivior's pricing power and indirectly benefits Vivitrol. Indivior's market dominance and patent litigation history (disclosed in 10-K competitive analysis) define Alkermes' competitive positioning. Indivior's 2020 opioid-litigation settlement ($600M) reflects sector-wide liability exposure.

competitors.name: Purdue Pharma L.P.
competitors.relationshipNote: Purdue Pharma (private, bankrupt 2019) is the originator of OxyContin and faces massive opioid-litigation liability ($600M+ settlements). Purdue's bankruptcy settlement and opioid-settlement funding create demand for MAT products like Vivitrol. Purdue's legacy liability and settlement obligations indirectly support Vivitrol adoption through increased opioid-crisis funding and criminal-justice diversion programs. Purdue's bankruptcy and settlement disclosures are disclosed in news and statutory filings.

competitors.name: Janssen Pharmaceuticals (Johnson & Johnson)
competitors.relationshipNote: Janssen (J&J subsidiary) manufactures Risperdal Consta (risperidone extended-release) and Invega Sustenna (paliperidone extended-release), competing directly with Lybalvi in the long-acting antipsychotic market. Janssen's established market share and clinical evidence in schizophrenia and bipolar disorder create competitive pressure on Lybalvi launch and pricing. Janssen's CNS portfolio and market dominance are disclosed in Alkermes 10-K competitive analysis. Invega Sustenna is the market-leading long-acting antipsychotic; Lybalvi's competitive positioning vs. Invega is critical to Alkermes' growth.

competitors.name: Otsuka Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
competitors.brainNodeRole: Long-Acting Antipsychotic Competitor & Aripiprazole Market Leader
competitors.relationshipNote: Otsuka manufactures Abilify Maintena (aripiprazole extended-release), the market-leading long-acting antipsychotic competing directly with Lybalvi. Abilify Maintena's established clinical evidence, market share, and patient familiarity create significant competitive headwinds for Lybalvi launch. Otsuka's market dominance in long-acting injectables is disclosed in Alkermes 10-K competitive analysis. Abilify Maintena's patent expiration (2026-2027) creates opportunity for Lybalvi market share gains.

competitors.name: Lundbeck A/S
competitors.relationshipNote: Lundbeck manufactures Brintellix (vortioxetine) and other CNS products, competing with Alkermes in depression and anxiety treatment. Lundbeck's CNS portfolio and addiction-medicine programs create competitive pressure on Alkermes' pipeline. Lundbeck's CNS expertise and market positioning are disclosed in industry reports;.

competitors.name: Allergan (AbbVie)
competitors.relationshipNote: Allergan (acquired by AbbVie 2020) manufactures Botox and other CNS/psychiatry products. AbbVie's CNS portfolio and psychiatry focus create competitive pressure on Lybalvi and Alkermes' pipeline. AbbVie's acquisition of Allergan (2020, $63B) reflects strategic focus on specialty pharma and CNS;.

regulators.name: U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA)
regulators.relationshipNote: The FDA regulates Alkermes' drug approvals, manufacturing standards, and post-market safety monitoring. FDA approval decisions for Vivitrol (approved 2006), Lybalvi (approved 2020), and pipeline candidates directly impact revenue and valuation. FDA action letters, warning letters, and safety communications are disclosed in 8-K filings and 10-K risk factors; FDA inspection findings impact manufacturing compliance and supply-chain risk.

regulators.name: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)
regulators.relationshipNote: The SEC regulates Alkermes' financial disclosures, insider trading, and corporate governance. SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, DEF14A) are primary sources of financial and operational data. SEC enforcement actions or disclosure deficiencies could impact investor confidence and stock price. Alkermes' CIK 0000850261 is the canonical identifier for SEC filings.

regulators.name: U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA)
regulators.relationshipNote: The DEA regulates naltrexone and other controlled substances used in Vivitrol and Lybalvi, managing manufacturing quotas and distribution controls. DEA policy on opioid-crisis response and MAT access directly impacts Vivitrol demand. DEA scheduling changes or quota restrictions could impact Alkermes' supply chain and revenue. DEA buprenorphine waiver expansion (2023 rule change) increases MAT access but benefits Indivior more than Alkermes.

regulators.name: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS)
regulators.relationshipNote: CMS sets Medicare and Medicaid reimbursement rates for Vivitrol and Lybalvi, directly impacting net price realization and volume. CMS coverage decisions and prior-authorization policies are disclosed in Medicare coverage documents and CMS announcements. CMS reimbursement pressure is a key revenue headwind for Alkermes; CMS pricing pressure on specialty injectables creates margin compression risk.

regulators.name: Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA)
regulators.relationshipNote: SAMHSA sets federal policy on medication-assisted treatment, opioid-crisis response, and addiction-treatment funding. SAMHSA guidance on MAT access and Vivitrol adoption directly impacts demand. SAMHSA funding allocations to states and criminal-justice programs create policy-dependent demand for Alkermes' products. SAMHSA's 2023 opioid-settlement funding guidance ($18B+ allocated to states) drives MAT demand.

auditor.name: Deloitte & Touche LLP
auditor.relationshipNote: Deloitte & Touche LLP is Alkermes' independent auditor, responsible for annual financial statement audits and internal-control assessments. Deloitte's audit opinions and any audit qualifications are disclosed in 10-K filings. Auditor changes or audit disputes could signal financial or compliance issues. Deloitte's audit tenure and audit fees are disclosed in proxy filings.

JPMorgan's lending decisions and credit terms directly impact Alkermes' financial flexibility and debt covenants. JPMorgan's syndicated credit facility (2021 refinancing) provides $500M+ in liquidity; disclosed in 10-K debt schedule.

capitalProviders.name: Bank of America Merrill Lynch
capitalProviders.relationshipNote: Bank of America Merrill Lynch provides lending and investment-banking services to Alkermes. BofA's credit facilities and capital-markets support are disclosed in 10-K debt schedule. BofA's syndicated credit facility participation (2021 refinancing) provides liquidity support;.

capitalProviders.relationshipNote: Vanguard is a major institutional shareholder in Alkermes, holding >5% of outstanding shares (as of 2023). Vanguard's voting power and engagement on governance and strategy are disclosed in proxy filings (DEF14A). Vanguard's investment thesis and shareholder activism influence Alkermes' capital allocation and strategic direction. Vanguard's ESG engagement on addiction-medicine access creates strategic alignment.

BlackRock's investment thesis and shareholder activism influence Alkermes' capital allocation and strategic direction. BlackRock's ESG focus on addiction-medicine access and criminal-justice reform aligns with Alkermes' mission.

marketSignals.name: Vivitrol Prescription Volume & Net Price Realization
marketSignals.relationshipNote: Vivitrol quarterly prescription volume and net price per unit are key revenue drivers disclosed in earnings calls and 10-Q filings. Volume trends reflect MAT market penetration and competitive dynamics vs. buprenorphine; net price reflects payer pressure and formulary coverage. Vivitrol represents >50% of Alkermes revenue; volume/price trends are critical to valuation. Vivitrol volume growth has slowed (2021-2023) due to buprenorphine competition.

marketSignals.name: Lybalvi Launch Trajectory & Market Adoption
marketSignals.relationshipNote: Lybalvi quarterly revenue, prescription volume, and market-share gains are key growth drivers disclosed in earnings calls and 10-Q filings. Lybalvi launch success (approved 2020, launched 2021) is critical to offset Vivitrol maturation; competitive positioning vs. Abilify Maintena (Otsuka) and Invega Sustenna (Janssen) determines long-term growth trajectory. Lybalvi adoption rates are early-warning signal for Alkermes' pipeline execution.

marketSignals.name: Gross Margin & Operating Leverage
marketSignals.relationshipNote: Gross margin and operating expense trends reflect manufacturing efficiency, supply-chain cost inflation, and commercial spending. Gross margin compression signals pricing pressure or manufacturing cost increases; operating leverage reflects commercial execution and R&D efficiency. Margin trends are disclosed in 10-Q filings and earnings calls. Alkermes' gross margin (2022-2023: ~70%) is under pressure from Vivitrol competition and manufacturing costs.
